text:
marta: Quick coordination - we're scheduling a staged toggle for `epoch_kv_cache_v2` tonight. Plan: 10% -> 30% at 21:30 PT, health check at 21:45, then 60% if stable at 23:00. Safe default remains OFF. Who can own the window and rollback?

raj: I can take ownership for the window. I'll be available 21:00-00:00 PT and can run the rollback if needed.

zoe: Heads up: this touches request-path cache layer. Watch short-prompt p99 and prefix KV hit-rate. Could see small flaps on warmups.

sam: Proposed quick smoke list (short):
- flip 10% in sandbox, run a 3m k6 smoke job
- curl /v1/health and /v1/embeddings simple request (see snippet)
- check p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, KV hit-rate delta
- verify traces for one sample request (trace id present)

Code snip for E2E probe:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello world"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY' | jq .status
```

anya: Add a single embed pipeline check too - sometimes ordering changes on cache.

infra-oncall: I'll prepare ephemeral dashboards and set alerts for the window: p99 increase > 20% for 5m, error rate > 0.4% for 3m, KV hit_rate drop > 12% for 3m. If any alert triggers we rollback immediately. I'll also attach a tiny pager note.

marta: Thanks. Please also post a short note in #support with a one-liner about potential transient latencies so CSE are aware.

sam: I'll draft the support blurb and paste here for approval.

raj: Toggle commands (internal CLI) I'll use: 
```
rw toggle preview epoch_kv_cache_v2 --env production --percent 10
rw toggle set epoch_kv_cache_v2 --env production --percent 30 --by raj --note "night staged roll"
rw toggle audit epoch_kv_cache_v2 --env production --samples 100
```
Rollback: 
```
rw toggle set epoch_kv_cache_v2 --env production --percent 0 --by raj
```

zoe: If we see any ordering or embed regressions, revert to 0 and set cache TTL to a conservative 50ms until we investigate.

deploy-bot: Planned: feature_toggle_epoch_kv_cache_v2 by raj @ 2027-03-05 21:30 PT - status: scheduled

raj: Timeline for tonight: 21:10 sandbox sanity, 21:30 flip to 30% (if sandbox ok), 21:45 smoke checks, 23:00 stage to 60% if all good. I'll ping here at each step.

infra-oncall: I'll be live-watching metrics. If I see sustained p99 spike or rising 5xxs I'll call for rollback.

marta: Perfect. Please keep messages brief during the window. See you all here 21:10 for preflight. :rocket:
